name: Furygale Flocking
oracle_text:
This spell costs {1} less to cast for each instant and sorcery card in your graveyard.
For each opponent, create two 3/3 blue and red Elemental creature tokens with flying that attack that opponent this turn if able. They gain haste until end of turn.
blocked_sentences: For each opponent, create two 3/3 blue and red Elemental creature tokens with flying that attack that opponent this turn if able.

needs.what: a this_turn duration on must_attack_player: the created creatures must attack a named player (here {"binding": "each_player"} inside for_each_player over opponents) during this turn's combat if able, and the requirement ends at this turn's cleanup
needs.why_existing_wont_do: must_attack_player names the defender but only accepts duration end_of_your_next_turn (structs.ATTACK_MARK_DURATIONS), which would also compel the tokens on your next turn; must_attack accepts this_turn but names no defender, so in multiplayer the tokens could attack any opponent instead of 'that opponent'; goad points away from a player and lasts too long. The rest of the card is expressible: cost_reduction count of Instant/Sorcery cards (any_types) in your graveyard, create_token elemental_3_3_ur_flying x2 per opponent with 'as', grant_keyword haste until end of turn on the binding.
